objective: Fill the sound gap between proved restricted hidden-evaluator classes and the arbitrary-hidden exact-law-equality fallback by computing exact noninferiority bounds over an independently justified finite admissible evaluator-world set.

minimum_information_extension.mechanism: Partition the admissible world set by candidate observable facts and rank facts whose possible observations most reduce unresolved sign ambiguity.

candidate_applications.GDPVAL_AA_V2_1: Represent only independently bounded judge/reference/harness uncertainty; if the worst compatible world still places Brain no worse than Opus, hidden owner details are irrelevant. Otherwise emit the load-bearing residual fact.
candidate_applications.CURSORBENCH_4_0: Do not fabricate a small world set from high-level public descriptions. Unless a sound completeness restriction appears, remain on U or use the separately verified stronger scope-complete capability replacement route.
